impact.summary: Safari's WebKit network cache under ~/Library/Caches/com.apple.Safari. macOS privacy controls (TCC) protect this location: it is read only with Full Disk Access, which this build neither probes nor requests, so the rule reports permission_required.
impact.regeneration: Resources are downloaded again from the network when pages are next visited.
impact.offline_effect: Pages and resources that were only cached cannot be shown offline until downloaded again.
